==Notes==
*This skill is available during [[Scarred Psyche]].
*When used, the user will shout one of those random quotes:
:''"All work and no play makes <[[character]] name> a dull hero."''
:''"Club soda removes nearly all bloodstains."''
:''"Don't believe their lies! It IS crunchy in the rain!"''
:''"Food is just another government conspiracy. Like sleeping, or air. Don't be a slave!"''
:''"I am the mighty... ummm... I forget."''
:''"I lost my harmonica, Albert."''
:''"I want to live amongst the peaceful gulls. CAW! CAW!"''
:''"It's just the king of the lizards fighting the dinosaur. RAWR!"''
:''"MORE COWBELL! It pleases the cheetah!"''
:''"Oh look! Rainbows!"''
:''"People say I'm strange. But what do they know? They're just figments of my imagination."''
:''"Stupid turtles in the sky! What do you want from me!?"''
:''"The leprechaun tells me to burn things."''
:''"The mangoes will avenge me!"''
:''"We can't stop here, this is [[Blood Drinker (NPC)|Blood Drinker]] country!"''

==Trivia==
*The [[skill icon]] is similar to [[Panic]].
*''"All work and no play makes <character name> a dull hero."'' is a reference to the [[w:All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy|All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy]] proverb.
*''"I lost my harmonica, Albert."'' was spoken by Paul Simon when recording his song [[w:A Simple Desultory Philippic (or How I Was Robert McNamara'd into Submission)|A Simple Desultory Philippic]].
*''"MORE COWBELL! It pleases the cheetah!"'' is a reference to the [[w:More cowbell|more cowbell]] catchphrase, similar to the [[More Cowbell]] quest.
*''"Oh look! Rainbows!"'': [[w:Double Rainbow (viral video)|Double Rainbow]] is a viral video about seeing more than one rainbow.
*''"The leprechaun tells me to burn things."'' is a reference to The Simpsons episode [[w:This Little Wiggy|This Little Wiggy]].
*''"We can't stop here, this is Blood Drinker country!"'' is a reference to [[w:Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas|Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas]]: "We can't stop here, this is bat country".
